svg.title: Surface of revolution with a midpoint radius
svg.desc: The curve y equals the square root of x is revolved about the x axis from 0 to 4. Parallel circular cuts bound a thin blue curved strip. The representative x is halfway between the cuts. Near edges are solid and far edges dashed. An enlarged local frustum below shows the radius square root of x at its axial midpoint and ds along its sloping side. The hatched end disk is a cross-section, not part of the lateral surface element.
